points.name: shoulder_left
points.instruction: Left outer shoulder point: where the shoulder seam meets the sleeve

points.name: shoulder_right
points.instruction: Right outer shoulder point: where the shoulder seam meets the sleeve

points.name: neck_shoulder
points.instruction: Highest point of the shoulder seam, right next to the collar/neckline (left side)

points.name: hem_center
points.instruction: Bottom hem, in a straight line below the neck_shoulder point

points.name: chest_left
points.instruction: Left armpit: where the sleeve seam meets the side seam

points.name: chest_right
points.instruction: Right armpit: where the sleeve seam meets the side seam

points.name: waist_left
points.instruction: Left side seam at waist level (narrowest part; for straight garments halfway between armpit and hem)

points.name: waist_right
points.instruction: Right side seam at the same height as waist_left

points.name: hip_left
points.instruction: Left side seam at hip level, about 18-20 cm below the waist point (widest part below the waist)

points.name: hip_right
points.instruction: Right side seam at the same height as hip_left

points.name: hem_left
points.instruction: Left bottom corner of the hem

points.name: hem_right
points.instruction: Right bottom corner of the hem

points.name: sleeve_end
points.instruction: Left sleeve: outer corner of the cuff / sleeve end (skip if sleeveless)
